title: A PowerShell child that TermAl terminates during startup leaves its __PSScriptPolicyTest_* probe files in the user's %TEMP%
outcome: It is decided whether TermAl should keep PowerShell probe leftovers out of the user's %TEMP% when it terminates a PowerShell child (an Engram .ps1 shim or another script) during startup, for example by giving such children a TermAl-owned temp directory that TermAl cleans, and that is implemented or recorded as accepted.
acceptance: A PowerShell child that TermAl terminates during startup leaves its __PSScriptPolicyTest_* probe files in the user's %TEMP% is done
